intro: Saint Lucia is a volcanic island famous for its twin Pitons, and it has produced two Nobel Prize winners.

chapters.title: Kalinago and Europeans
text: The Kalinago (Island Caribs) lived on the island and resisted European settlers for years.

chapters.title: The 'Helen of the West Indies'
text: Britain and France fought over Saint Lucia so often that it changed hands 14 times, earning the nickname 'Helen of the West Indies'. Britain finally kept it in 1814.

highlight.title: Fourteen times
highlight.text: The island switched between Britain and France 14 times.

chapters.title: Independence
text: Saint Lucia became independent in 1979. It remains a Commonwealth realm with the British monarch as head of state.

keyTerms.meaning: Indigenous people of the eastern Caribbean.
